additional_info.body:
Dear Emre-abi,
Thank you for reaching
out
to eMobility Support. My name is
Francisco
, and I will be assisting you with your following query today:
Product
: Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset
:
MP/S4170003525
ChargerID/Serial No.
:
zWXyBe
Problem Description
: DC1_CableTempSensor_XD100
Troubleshooting
: I checked via SSH the temperature sensors and here is what we have at the moment:
This is in Ohms, so it seems that either there is something wrong with the cable or the StateMonitor
Please start measuring from the XD410:9B and 10D to their respective 0V, if the measurement is already different from 1kOhm here, you can replace the cable.
If these points are measuring 1kOhm then we need to move on the next points, after the connector, XD410:9A and 10C, until the StateMonitor.
If the 1kOhm is again not noticed after the XD410, then maybe there is a loose wiring or the connector (very unlikely).
If the 1kOhm is reaching the StateMonitor but we still see this error, please try to swap the EcoG connector with a neighbour one that is not currently being used:
Example
If this still doesn't work please replace the KF14.
For future reference, your case number is
0415580
, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Francisco de Matos Joaquim
Please do not
change
the
subject of this Email when
replying
to it.
